candidate.description: A candidate segment the segment importer stages in the AppView before publishing it: a public line, such as an OpenStreetMap trail, validated as feed.segment is. Never served by any feed query, matched for efforts, or counted as a duplicate of a segment.

id.description: The importer's stable id for the candidate, of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

sport.description: The sport group whose activities count as its riders.

line.description: The line from start to end as an encoded polyline at precision 6, as feed.segment#line.

source.description: Where the line came from, as feed.segment#source.

license.description: The licence of the line's data, as an SPDX identifier such as ODbL-1.0.

attribution.description: Who to credit for the line's data, as feed.segment#attribution. Blank is taken as none.

rejection.description: A staged candidate the AppView refused, and why.
